title: MULTILINGUAL HATECHECK: Functional Tests for Multilingual Hate Speech Detection Models
measurement_description: The paper measures a model's ability to detect hate speech targeting various protected groups, including religious groups (Muslims and Jews), across ten languages. The evaluation uses a functional test suite called MULTILINGUAL HATECHECK (MHC) to diagnose model weaknesses and biases in target coverage.
findings: The tested model (XTC, a fine-tuned XLM-T) exhibited biased target coverage, meaning its performance in detecting hate speech varied depending on the targeted protected group. For example, in tests for French, Italian, and Mandarin, the model's F1 score on cases targeting Muslims was 66.2, 69.0, and 68.3 respectively, showing performance differences compared to other protected groups like women or disabled people.
